verdict.rationale: Evidence shows HelixDB supports vector indexes and ranks pre-computed embeddings (helixdb-docs-3, helixdb-probe-1) but nowhere documents the database itself generating embeddings from raw text/queries via built-in or configurable model providers — users still appear to bring their own vectors. No mention of embedding model configuration, provider integration, or automatic embedding generation at ingest/query time anywhere in the docs or community evidence.
